credits.title: Trinidad
credits.overview: Trinidad flees persecution in Spain for the wild west. Along the way, she earns renown for her weapons skills but also becomes a target of enemies, such as the widow Bronson.

credits.title: Your Fault
credits.overview: The love between Noah and Nick seems unwavering despite their parents' attempts to separate them. But his job and her entry into college open up their lives to new relationships that will shake the foundations of both their relationship and the Leister family itself.

credits.title: Tell Me What You Want
credits.overview: After his father's death, Eric Zimmerman travels to Spain to oversee his company's branches. In Madrid, he falls for Judith and engage in an intense, erotic relationship full of exploration. However, Eric fears his secret may end their affair.

credits.title: Dreams and Crumbs
credits.overview: Javi and Dani go around the city trying to sell a stolen painting.
